questions.question: What did wicked King Ahaz of Judah do?
options: Made a lasting peace with Assyria
Repaired the temple and restored its true worship
Removed the idols from the high places
Sacrificed to other gods and even his own son
questions.answer: Sacrificed to other gods and even his own son

questions.question: To whom did Ahaz appeal for help, becoming his vassal?
Ahaz put up a pagan-style altar in place of the bronze altar at the temple.
King _____ of Judah even sacrificed his own son in the fire.
Ahaz sent tribute and asked the king of _____ to rescue him.
